whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Biryani Mall,

I noticed your restaurant has massive popularity with over 11,500+ reviews on Fraser Road in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering & table reservation page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp takeaway ordering, digital menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/biryanimall

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team The Biryani Mall, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (The Biryani Mall) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with a digital food menu, direct WhatsApp takeaway ordering, and your Fraser Road location directions. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual food photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
